name: Ed Cook
story: At the 2018 New Zealand Esri User Conference, Ed Cook presented on ArcGIS web maps and field apps. The 2019 programme also names him with Beth-Anne Lee in two sessions on ArcGIS Field Apps, covering QuickCapture, Survey123, Collector and workflows that combine the apps.

contentSections.title: Documented contribution in 2021
paragraphs: Developed the Taranaki CDEM Geospatial Strategy with Teresa Gordon, supported by Nathan Heazlewood. The May 2021 strategy joins governance and skills with user requirements, interoperable data and technology investment.
